meta.network: TR4 LV network, 46 PV-BESS prosumers in 3 aggregators; aggregate converter rating 165.6 kW / 165.6 kVA
meta.coordinates: deviation (dP, dQ) from the interface exchange with all BESS idle; kW / kvar; positive = import
meta.csv_content: FOR_rolling<tag>.csv P,Q = absolute interface exchange in MW/Mvar (positive = import); converted here
meta.idle_reference: B(t) = executed interface exchange of the no-request run minus the fleet BESS P (Pexec) and Q (Qinv1) of that slot
meta.slot_mapping: rolling step k (CSV now) -> flexibility slot k+1 (CSV target) -> clock = start of slot = (slot-1)*30 min; slots 1-48 day 1, 49-96 day 2 (day-2 now + 48); day-1 step 48 builds slot 49 (day 2 00:00)
meta.requested_slots_definition: TSO export request every half-hour 06:00-20:00 of day 1 (flexibility slots 13-40, the FOR boundary point with the most export); none on day 2
meta.availability: F_{k+1} is only built when the run needs it: no-request run at every step of day 1 (separate run, same trajectory); export runs only at the requested slots 13-40 of day 1. Day-2 FORs exist only as same-state copies (slots whose building step has the same per-prosumer SOC and frozen slot-1 plan as the no-request step at the same clock time). soc_bound_* are given for every slot.

fields.export_capability_kW: -dP_min: largest extra export vs all-idle (negative = the FOR does not reach the idle point: the fleet must charge at least that much)
fields.operating_point: executed interface exchange of the slot, as deviation (P1 baseline when there is no request)
fields.p1_baseline_point: P1-baseline point of the step (S0) at requested slots
fields.service_vs_p1_baseline: requested point minus P1-baseline point [dP kW, dQ kvar]; dt * sum(max(0,-dP)) = export served
fields.soc_mean_pct: mean SOC of the 46 BESS at the start of the slot
fields.stored_energy_above_floor_kWh: sum over BESS of (SOC - (1-DOD)) * E, at the start of the slot
fields.soc_bound_export_kW: BESS-only bound sum min(P, (SOC-SOCmin) E eta / dt); ignores the self-consumption guarantee and network
fields.soc_bound_import_kW: BESS-only bound sum min(P, (1-SOC) E / (eta dt)); tracks dP_max closely (see soc_bound_check)

no_request.label: No TSO request
no_request.for_from: N2/_REF_SWEEP_free_today_a2x4p8fin_TR4_FairBox1 (day 1; executed trajectory identical to the no-request run, max diff 0.0e+00)
